source.name: kb curated topic map
source.note: Topic map for containers, Kubernetes, cloud and delivery; lessons and problems come later.

topics.name: Containers
topics.usage: Images, layers, registries and runtime isolation (namespaces, cgroups): the unit you ship.

topics.name: Kubernetes architecture
topics.usage: Control plane (API server, etcd, scheduler, controllers) and nodes (kubelet): desired state reconciled in a loop.

topics.name: Pods, Deployments & StatefulSets
topics.usage: Workload objects: replicas, rolling updates, probes, and when you need stable identity and storage.

topics.name: Services, Ingress & networking
topics.usage: Service discovery, ClusterIP/LoadBalancer, Ingress/Gateway, DNS and network policies.

topics.name: Scheduling & autoscaling
topics.usage: Requests/limits, affinity, HPA/VPA and cluster autoscaling.

topics.name: Storage: volumes & PVCs
topics.usage: PersistentVolumes, claims, storage classes and stateful workloads.

topics.name: Config & secrets
topics.usage: ConfigMaps, Secrets, external secret stores and rotating credentials safely.

topics.name: Helm & packaging
topics.usage: Templated, versioned releases of a set of manifests; values per environment.

topics.name: Cloud fundamentals
topics.usage: Regions and availability zones, shared responsibility, managed vs self-run, pricing models.

topics.name: Identity & access (IAM)
topics.usage: Principals, roles, policies and least privilege; workload identity instead of static keys.

topics.name: VPC networking
topics.usage: Subnets, routing, NAT, security groups, private endpoints and peering.

topics.name: Cloud storage
topics.usage: Object vs block vs file storage, storage tiers and durability guarantees.

topics.name: Serverless
topics.usage: Functions and managed containers: scale to zero, cold starts, event triggers, limits.

topics.name: Infrastructure as code
topics.usage: Declarative infra (Terraform, Pulumi): plans, state, modules and drift.

topics.name: CI/CD
topics.usage: Build, test and deploy pipelines; artifacts, environments and promotion.

topics.name: GitOps
topics.usage: Git as the source of truth; a controller (Argo CD, Flux) reconciles the cluster to it.

topics.name: Deployment strategies
topics.usage: Rolling, blue-green, canary and feature flags; fast, safe rollback.

topics.name: Observability & SLOs
topics.usage: Metrics, logs and traces; SLIs, SLOs and error budgets; alerting on symptoms.

topics.name: Cost optimization (FinOps)
topics.usage: Right-sizing, autoscaling, spot capacity, storage tiers and cost visibility per team.
